title: Backend Engineer learning roadmap
summary: A step-by-step guide to become a competent backend engineer from scratch. It covers fundamentals, core backend skills, portfolio projects, and job-ready preparation.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build a solid base in programming, data, and web basics.

milestones.title: Learn Python basics
milestones.outcome: Write simple Python scripts and understand core language constructs.

tasks.title: Read Python intro on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Study the freeCodeCamp Python basics module and take the end-of-section quiz.

tasks.title: Write a calculator script
tasks.description: Implement a command-line calculator handling +, -, *, / and error cases.

tasks.title: Practice list comprehensions
tasks.description: Create three list-comprehension examples that filter and transform data.

tasks.title: Reflect on common errors
tasks.description: Note down the most frequent syntax and runtime errors you encountered and how you fixed them.

milestones.title: Understand relational databases
milestones.outcome: Design simple tables and run basic SQL queries.

tasks.title: Read SQL tutorial on MDN
tasks.description: Follow MDN’s SQL basics guide and complete the interactive examples.

tasks.title: Create a SQLite database
tasks.description: Install SQLite, define a contacts table, and insert sample rows using the CLI.

tasks.title: Practice SELECT queries
tasks.description: Write SELECT statements with WHERE, ORDER BY, and GROUP BY on your contacts table.

tasks.title: Connect with a Python script
tasks.description: Use Python’s sqlite3 module to fetch and display contacts data.

tasks.title: Reflect on normalization
tasks.description: Summarize first, second, and third normal forms in your own words.

milestones.title: Web fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Explain how the web works and make a basic HTTP request.

tasks.title: Watch HTTP overview on Khan Academy
tasks.description: Learn about request/response cycles, status codes, and headers.

tasks.title: Use curl to fetch a page
tasks.description: Run curl to retrieve https://example.com and view the raw response headers.

tasks.title: Read MDN’s HTTP methods article
tasks.description: Understand GET, POST, PUT, DELETE and when to use each.

tasks.title: Write a simple Flask app
tasks.description: Create a Flask route that returns ‘Hello World’ and run it locally.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Gain expertise in API design, authentication, caching, and testing.

milestones.title: Design RESTful APIs
milestones.outcome: Define resources, endpoints, and proper HTTP semantics for a service.

tasks.title: Read REST design guide on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Study the principles of resource naming, status codes, and versioning.

tasks.title: Sketch API spec for a todo app
tasks.description: Write endpoint definitions (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) and request/response schemas on paper or a doc.

tasks.title: Implement todo endpoints in Flask
tasks.description: Code the CRUD routes using Flask and SQLite, returning JSON responses.

tasks.title: Test endpoints with Postman
tasks.description: Send requests to each route, verify status codes and payloads.

tasks.title: Reflect on idempotence
tasks.description: Explain why PUT and DELETE should be idempotent in your own words.

milestones.title: Add authentication and security
milestones.outcome: Secure APIs with token-based authentication and basic best practices.

tasks.title: Read JWT intro on Auth0 blog
tasks.description: Understand how JSON Web Tokens are structured and verified.

tasks.title: Generate JWTs in Python
tasks.description: Write a script that creates and decodes JWTs using PyJWT.

tasks.title: Protect Flask routes with JWT
tasks.description: Add a decorator that checks the Authorization header before allowing access.

tasks.title: Practice password hashing
tasks.description: Use bcrypt to hash and verify passwords in a signup/login flow.

tasks.title: Reflect on common attacks
tasks.description: List three OWASP API security risks and how your implementation mitigates them.

milestones.title: Implement caching and background jobs
milestones.outcome: Use a cache store and a queue system to improve performance and handle async work.

tasks.title: Read Redis quick start on Redis.io
tasks.description: Follow the official guide to install Redis locally and run basic commands.

tasks.title: Add Redis cache to Flask endpoint
tasks.description: Cache the result of a heavy computation for 5 minutes using redis-py.

tasks.title: Set up a Celery worker
tasks.description: Configure Celery with Redis broker and write a simple background task that sleeps then logs.

tasks.title: Practice retry logic
tasks.description: Modify the Celery task to retry on simulated failure up to three times.

tasks.title: Reflect on when to cache
tasks.description: Write a brief note describing scenarios where caching is beneficial versus harmful.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that showcase the core backend capabilities.

milestones.title: REST API with auth and tests
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate a production-grade API with JWT auth, unit and integration tests.

tasks.title: Plan project structure on paper
tasks.description: Outline folders, models, routes, and test layout for the API.

tasks.title: Code API endpoints
tasks.description: Implement at least three resources with full CRUD using Flask and SQLite.

tasks.title: Add JWT protection
tasks.description: Secure all routes except login/register with token verification.

tasks.title: Write pytest suite
tasks.description: Create unit tests for models and integration tests for each endpoint.

tasks.title: Document API with OpenAPI
tasks.description: Generate a Swagger spec and host it via Flask-Swagger UI.

milestones.title: URL shortener with analytics
milestones.outcome: Show ability to design data models, handle redirects, and record usage metrics.

tasks.title: Design schema for URLs and clicks
tasks.description: Create tables for short codes, original URLs, and click timestamps.

tasks.title: Implement shorten endpoint
tasks.description: Generate a unique short code and store mapping in the database.

tasks.title: Create redirect handler
tasks.description: Lookup short code, record click, and issue 301 redirect to original URL.

tasks.title: Add analytics endpoint
tasks.description: Return total clicks and recent click timestamps for a given short code.

tasks.title: Write basic tests
tasks.description: Verify shortening, redirection, and analytics responses with pytest.

milestones.title: Background job worker
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate asynchronous processing of tasks such as email sending or image resizing.

tasks.title: Define job payload schema
tasks.description: Specify JSON fields needed for the example job (e.g., image URL).

tasks.title: Create Celery task for image resize
tasks.description: Download image, resize with Pillow, and store result locally.

tasks.title: Build API to enqueue jobs
tasks.description: Expose a POST endpoint that validates payload and queues the Celery task.

tasks.title: Monitor worker logs
tasks.description: Run the Celery worker and observe task execution and retries.

tasks.title: Reflect on scaling options
tasks.description: Write a short note on how to scale workers and broker in production.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced topics, build a professional presence, and prepare for interviews or client work.

milestones.title: Advanced testing strategies
milestones.outcome: Apply property-based, load, and security testing to your services.

tasks.title: Read hypothesis intro on Hypothesis.readthedocs.io
tasks.description: Learn property-based testing concepts and install the library.

tasks.title: Add hypothesis tests for API inputs
tasks.description: Write tests that generate random valid and invalid request payloads.

tasks.title: Run load test with Locust
tasks.description: Create a simple Locust script to simulate 100 concurrent users on your API.

tasks.title: Perform security scan with OWASP ZAP
tasks.description: Run ZAP against your API and note any reported vulnerabilities.

tasks.title: Reflect on test coverage gaps
tasks.description: Identify areas lacking tests and plan improvements.

milestones.title: Deploy and monitor services
milestones.outcome: Launch a backend service to the cloud and set up basic observability.

tasks.title: Read Heroku deployment guide
tasks.description: Follow Heroku’s free tier tutorial to deploy a Flask app with a PostgreSQL add-on.

tasks.title: Configure Redis add-on on Heroku
tasks.description: Enable Heroku Redis and update your app to use it for caching.

tasks.title: Set up health check endpoint
tasks.description: Add /health route that returns 200 when DB and Redis are reachable.

tasks.title: Add simple logging to CloudWatch
tasks.description: Stream Flask logs to AWS CloudWatch using the built-in handler.

tasks.title: Reflect on deployment challenges
tasks.description: Write a brief summary of any issues faced and how you resolved them.

milestones.title: Job-search readiness
milestones.outcome: Present a polished portfolio, résumé, and interview preparation plan.

tasks.title: Create a personal portfolio site
tasks.description: Build a static site on GitHub Pages that showcases your three projects with links to code and demos.

tasks.title: Write a concise technical résumé
tasks.description: Draft a one-page résumé highlighting skills, projects, and measurable outcomes.

tasks.title: Prepare STAR stories
tasks.description: Write three Situation-Task-Action-Result narratives for challenges you solved in projects.

tasks.title: Mock system design interview
tasks.description: Pair with a peer or use an online platform to practice designing a scalable backend service.

tasks.title: Connect with backend communities
tasks.description: Join two relevant Slack/Discord groups or attend a virtual meetup and introduce yourself.
